messages:
mina: Heads up 11:45 we saw p99 spike on the endpoint-level latency dashboard for /v1/complete. p50/p95 stable.
kevin: when I split by backend the spike vanishes. Looks like merged view is inflating the tail.
jonas: could be duplicate samples from retries or client fanout. t-digest merge counts each sample separately and will bias the tail.
tara: do we have request_id in samples? if yes, collapsing duplicates at query time is simplest.
mina: yes request_id present. quick check: grouping by request_id reduces p99 from 1.2s -> 190ms.
telemetry-bot: alert: route=/v1/complete p99 +45% vs baseline, sample_count=3120
kevin: API question: add ?dedupe=request_id param or auto-dedupe for merged endpoint views?
jonas: prefer query-time opt-in with console default-on for merged views. Ingest dedupe changes history irrevocably.
tara: UX: console should show a badge saying "dedup=request_id" and tooltip explaining impact. Also a per-tenant setting.
mina: I'll open a PR with ?dedupe param and a small console flag. Will include perf numbers (grouping adds ~10% CPU, +80ms for 200k samples).
kevin: add tests for t-digest merge + dedupe ordering (tie-breaker e.g., min latency).
jonas: good. Also provide a delta-report endpoint so customers can see how numbers change if they opt-in.
mina: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/1901. Scheduling staging canary.
telemetry-bot: staging deploy complete at 1747001200
mina: will run canary and post results here. Thanks everyone.
